name: outputty
description: A plugin for developing with Claude Code: /outputty:plan interviews, spikes every level, takes your pick and files one ticket; /outputty:tickets picks the next; /outputty:build takes it to one PR under a /goal, docs last, or to one stacked PR per layer when you label the ticket stack. Tickets live in GitHub Issues, through the tracker skill. /outputty:init copies the rules under ~/.claude/ and the templates into the repo.

plugins.name: outputty
plugins.description: The skills plan, prototype, tickets, build, audit, retro, tracker, herdr, documentation, data-engineering, frontend and typescript-node, each as /outputty:<name>; the standing lines, through a SessionStart hook; and a forced output style. /outputty:init copies the code rules, a rule file per language, a ticket template, a PR template, a README template and settings; each copy is edited where it lands, and a re-run reports drift per file. A build runs under /goal; review is /code-review.
